acceptance: A test launches a seat whose write grant is refused, and the launch error names the write grant, not nesting; red before the fix.
A test with a probe that is not capable under a nested env still names nesting.

consumed.resolution: already done on main (verified by the inbox review of 2026-11-20, adversarial pass): WrapOutcome typed result carries refusal cause; both acceptance tests exist

fix: Carry the refusal reason of the wrap out of SandboxWrapper (a typed result instead of a bool), and make sandboxRequiredButUnavailable and the safety gate report that reason. Report nesting only when the probe was the cause.
summary: On 2026-11-17 a console-builder seat run with --project-root equal to --worktree failed 4 times with launch exit=2. The final error and the launch-error file named 'nested LLM-CLI session: inner sandbox unavailable'. The real cause was one stderr line earlier: 'sandbox write grant unavailable: write grant {worktree_path} covers the run directories of other cycles'. defaultSandboxWrapWithProbe (go/internal/bridge/sandbox_wrap.go) returns false, and sandboxRequiredButUnavailable then asks ConfinementSatisfied, which reports nesting from the CLAUDECODE env, not the refusal that happened.
title: A refused sandbox write grant ends a seat launch with the reason nested LLM-CLI session
